1 The El. A skyscraper lies on its side across the second leg: its body off the right, its broken top buried in a grassed rubble ridge 11 m high (3 m at the low end by the El). The second is blind, over the marker on the crest.
2 The Atrium. The subway caved in under the first leg: a trench 7 m deep where the drives land. You play up and out of it to the courtyard green.
4 Broken Tower. The green sits on the floor slab of a gutted pavilion, 2.2 m up, with broken steps as a false front and columns still standing.

5 The Stadium. An earthquake brought most of it down: only the east side keeps its tiers. The north stand slumped into the bowl as rubble, and the back of a bigger green rolls up onto it as a second tier. A sinkhole short of the green leaves 17 m of short grass before the front edge.
7 The Bridge. The quake tipped the riverside street: it falls 3% to the right, away from the water, and its raised edge breaks off in a 5 m drop just past the rough on the river side.
All holes. Buckled streets: quake rolls of a metre or so under every fairway (greens and tees left level).
